Re-running --comp full --mc-only would take ~6-12 hours of compute. The Apr-21 outputs (welfare6.tex + welfare6_parallel_summary.json + 12 scenario .pkl files) are intact and content-addressable, the recipe is unambiguously documented in do_all.py:209, and the run-time HEAD is identifiable from git log around the run window. This manifest captures all of that information so the Apr-21 results can serve as the canonical MC anchor without re-spending the compute.
